primary_claim: After a significant directional 30-minute price impulse, the state in which open interest expands while price exhibits weak continuation in the impulse direction is associated with stronger subsequent 60-minute reversal than comparable impulse episodes without the full OI-expansion / weak-continuation state.

v3_non_applicability.v3_trap_role: reason MARKET-01 prospectively includes a temporal robustness downgrade layer only

price.close_at_clock_T: close of the canonical 1m bar whose bar_end_exclusive equals T; still-forming bar never used

open_interest.legal_oi_at_clock_U: latest observation with available_at <= U AND (U - available_at) <= 300000 ms

historical_normalization.window: previous 30 calendar days ending before impulse_start
historical_normalization.reference_population: UTC 5-minute boundaries tau with 30-minute price window [tau-30m, tau] fully legally available, tau in [impulse_start - 30*86400000ms, impulse_start)

impulse.QUALIFYING_IMPULSE: P_impulse >= 0.90 AND N_ref >= 1 AND D defined

oi_expansion.OI_end: legal OI at U = T = t+30m

historical_normalization.window: previous 30 calendar days ending before state_start
historical_normalization.reference_population: UTC 5-minute boundaries tau in [state_start - 30*86400000ms, state_start) with legal_OI(tau) and legal_OI(tau-30m) defined, finite, and strictly positive

candidate_and_baseline.BASELINE: QUALIFYING_IMPULSE AND confirmatory-eligible (valid inputs, stratum, finite reversal_return, span inside common period) AND NOT CANDIDATE
do_not_match_on: post-impulse/state information other than candidate identity

overlap_policy.walk_order: chronological UTC 5-minute impulse endpoints t ascending
overlap_policy.conflict_resolution: chronologically earliest eligible qualifying impulse wins
overlap_policy.occupancy: an accepted QUALIFYING_IMPULSE occupies the 120-minute slot even if later OI/state/stratum/outcome checks make it EPISODE_NOT_ELIGIBLE for confirmatory use

trailing_volatility.authority: B2-03 / B2-02 unique frozen pre-state VOL_STATE statistic
trailing_volatility.h01_RV_L_not_used: H01 RV_L uses the same L=60 formula as a feature search surface with L in {30,60,120}; MARKET-01 does not use L in {30,120} and does not treat H01 search-surface L as the matching state
trailing_volatility.evaluation_clock: impulse endpoint t (pre-state; window does not include STATE FORMATION [t, t+30m])
trailing_volatility.formula: sqrt(sum_{i=1..60} r_i^2); r_i=ln(close_i/close_{i-1}); close_0=close(t-60m); close_1..close_60 cover [t-60m, t) exactly 60 complete 1m bars; available_at<=t for close_0 and all 60 bars

tertile_boundaries.computed_from: historical observations legally available before impulse_start of the current episode
tertile_boundaries.window: previous 30 calendar days ending before impulse_start
tertile_boundaries.reference_population_impulse_magnitude: UTC 5-minute boundaries tau in [impulse_start - 30*86400000ms, impulse_start) with abs(ln(close(tau)/close(tau-30m))) fully legally available
tertile_boundaries.reference_population_trailing_vol: UTC 5-minute boundaries tau in [impulse_start - 30*86400000ms, impulse_start) with PRE_VOL_60(tau) fully legally available at window end tau

stratification.stratum_id_format: uppercase LOW/MID/HIGH, single '|', no direction field, no whitespace

support_and_identifiability.confirmatory_sample: accepted confirmatory-eligible episodes with valid candidate/baseline identity, valid stratum, finite reversal_return, full span inside common legal period
support_and_identifiability.non_usable_strata: reportable diagnostics only; do not enter primary confirmatory regression

design_matrix.stratum_dummies: one dummy column per usable stratum_id sorted lexicographically

bootstrap.sequence_order: decision time T ascending, then impulse_start ascending
bootstrap.circular_wrap_scope: within the confirmatory episode sequence only

block_length_selector.algorithm_reference: Politis, D.N. and White, H. (2004), Automatic Block-Length Selection for the Dependent Bootstrap, Econometric Reviews 23(1):53-70; correction Patton, A., Politis, D.N. and White, H. (2009), Econometric Reviews 28(4):372-375
block_length_selector.branch: stationary-bootstrap only (c=2, b_sb); circular-bootstrap branch unused
block_length_selector.repository_algorithm_reuse: scripts/research/harness_synthetic_edge_calibration_v3_confirmatory.py:optimal_stationary_block_length as algorithm identity only; not V3 DETECTED; not Clark-West estimand

input_series.name: z
input_series.definition: Frisch-Waugh OLS influence for beta_candidate after within-usable-stratum demeaning
input_series.M: residual maker onto the usable-stratum dummy columns (not including candidate_indicator)
input_series.scale_invariance_note: PW/PPW autocovariance selector is invariant to positive scalar multiple

block_length_selector.rng_for_selector: none; deterministic function of observed z
block_length_selector.round: Python 3 round half-to-even of a real number to nearest integer

replicate_draw.start: uniform on {0, ..., n-1} via numpy Generator.integers(0, n)
replicate_draw.block_length: i.i.d. Geometric(p_geom) on {1,2,...} via numpy Generator.geometric(p_geom)
replicate_draw.indices: (start + j) mod n; concatenate until length n; truncate
replicate_draw.refit: same section-14 OLS on resampled tuples, same primary usable-stratum dummy column set
replicate_draw.rank_deficient_or_nonfinite_replicate: entire primary confirmatory test = NOT_IDENTIFIABLE_OR_INSUFFICIENT_SUPPORT; no redraw; no drop

studentized_one_sided_p_value.SE_hat: sample std of {beta*_b}, ddof=1; equivalently numpy.std(beta_star, ddof=1)
studentized_one_sided_p_value.centering: replicate coefficients centered at observed beta_hat
studentized_one_sided_p_value.arithmetic_authority: same one-sided SB p-value construction already frozen in the repository; applied to beta_candidate, not V3 theta_hat

bootstrap.DETECTED: support/identifiability pass AND beta_hat > 0 AND p_one_sided <= 0.05

leave_one_era_out.sample: primary confirmatory usable-stratum episodes with T not in ERA_k
sign_stable_false_if: any primary usable stratum has remaining candidate_count < 5 or remaining baseline_count < 5
OLS rank-deficient or any coefficient non-finite

concentration.candidate_share_k: count of primary confirmatory candidates with T in ERA_k / count of primary confirmatory candidates

CASE_1.when: primary support/identifiability requirements fail, including bootstrap selector/replicate/SE failure
CASE_1.label: NOT_IDENTIFIABLE_OR_INSUFFICIENT_SUPPORT

CASE_2.when: primary test valid AND (beta_hat <= 0 OR p_one_sided > 0.05)
CASE_2.label: NO_EVIDENCE

CASE_3.when: primary DETECTED (beta_hat > 0 AND p_one_sided <= 0.05) AND ROBUSTNESS_PASS = false
CASE_3.label: DETECTED_BUT_NOT_ROBUST

final_classification.ROBUST_CANDIDATE_means: the preregistered MARKET-01 relationship produced positive primary evidence and survived the frozen temporal robustness downgrade checks

forbidden_after_this_prereg: changing support floors or era bounds
inspecting outcomes to choose among tests
selective rerun or post-outcome threshold repair
